title: Cats loved the toys but not the treats
text: The cats loved the toys but not the treats. They were like homemade soft treats and not one (out of 7) would touch them. I tried to change the box without the food/treats but couldn't do that and if I cancelled and re-ordered it appears they would get the same box....so I cancelled and went to KitNipBox. Looks like same and it is $3 less a month. I hate when you cant get help easily.
label: neutral
